scoring_justification: Recomputing from raw DFT total-energy outputs or TDDFT spectra is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring by comparing agent's reported values to paper-reported reference values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for formation energies, stacking energy, expected absorption peaks, and dipole strength targets derived from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Fig. 2 and text for formation energies; text for stacking energy and dipole strengths; Fig. 3 and text for absorption peaks.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values in the original paper, necessary for comparison.

outputs.description: DFT formation energies along the synthesis pathway, scored by comparison to paper values within tolerance.

schema.description: Species names as top-level keys, each mapping to an array of peak objects.

outputs.description: Main absorption peak positions from TDDFT, checked for ordering and presence of characteristic peaks.

schema.description: Species names as keys mapping to integrated dipole strength per monomer unit (Debye^2).

outputs.description: Dipole strength per monomer, scored by the trend (increase from monomer to tetramer, decrease upon stacking) relative to paper data.
Stacking energy of the planar stacked IMIM-IMIM octamer, compared to paper value within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces formation energies, absorption peaks, dipole strengths, and stacking energy as reported in the paper. Exact values are hidden; scoring uses tolerances and trend checks appropriate for a re-run with different implementation.
